standard.summary: DoRA 模式：下列可选值说明含换档影响。
standard.effect: 不同枚举会改变算法目标、资源占用或导出兼容性。
standard.whenToUse: 先默认，再按显存/质量/兼容目标换档。
standard.avoidWhen: 未做短测对照前不要同时叠多个激进实验档。

optionDescriptions.split: 方向幅度分开存/更，方便拆开看。
optionDescriptions.merged: 合并成更像普通权重的样子，导出好说话。
optionDescriptions.structure: 只训方向(结构),幅度保持不动。
optionDescriptions.style: 只训幅度(强度),方向保持不动。

standard_en.summary: DoRA mode: the values below include what changing gear does.
standard_en.effect: Different enum values change the algorithm's target, its resource use, or export compatibility.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start on the default, then change gear according to your VRAM, quality or compatibility goal.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive experimental gears before running a short controlled test.

optionDescriptions.split: Stores and updates direction and magnitude apart, which is easier to inspect separately.
optionDescriptions.merged: Merges them into something closer to an ordinary weight, which exports more easily.
optionDescriptions.structure: Trains direction (structure) only, leaving magnitude fixed.
optionDescriptions.style: Trains magnitude (strength) only, leaving direction fixed.
